pages.text: More complicated machines and blocks need to be created in an assembler.$(br2)These mechanical crafters require a minimum (and sometimes maximum) amount of rotational power to function.

One of the faces acts as the output, while the others act as the input.$(br2)Using hoppers or pipes, items can be piped into these slots.$(br2)The simple assmelber can only hold up to 4 different item types.$(br2)Right-click the assembler to select a recipe, otherwise it will craft whatever it can with the items available.
